layers.name: NDVI Vegetation Index
layers.description: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index from Sentinel-2 (10m). Measures crop vigor & canopy density.

layers.name: EVI Vegetation Index
layers.description: Enhanced Vegetation Index. Reduced atmospheric and soil background interference for high biomass.

layers.name: Soil pH (Reaction)
layers.description: Acidity / Alkalinity level (0-14 scale). Optimal range for Deccan vertisols is 6.5 - 7.8.

layers.name: Soil Organic Carbon (SOC)
layers.description: Organic Carbon percentage in topsoil (0-15 cm). Key driver of microbial health and nutrient buffering.

layers.name: Available Nitrogen (N)
layers.description: Alkaline permanganate extractable Nitrogen (mg/kg). Equivalent to kg/ha (x2 factor).

layers.name: Bulk Density
layers.description: Dry mass of soil per unit volume (g/cm³). Indicator of compaction, root penetration and aeration.

layers.name: Elevation (DEM)
layers.description: Height above Mean Sea Level (m) derived from DEM. Controls hydrologic runoff & accumulation.

layers.name: DSM Prediction Uncertainty
layers.description: Quantile Regression Forest 90% prediction interval error. Lower values represent higher confidence.
